name: Orbit AI - Phase 1 - Demo generation trigger

nodes.name: Generate demo webhook
nodes.notes: Synchronous response (waits for the last node), unlike the lead-intake webhook - a rep clicking 'Generate Demo' on the Demo Dashboard reasonably wants to see success/failure, not just an ack. Reconsider if demo generation ends up too slow for a synchronous UI wait once real latency is known (checkpoint 4's README flags generation time as unmeasured against the live Claude API).

nodes.name: Call demo generator

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ vertical: $json.body.vertical, niche: $json.body.niche, gbpUrl: $json.body.gbpUrl, websiteUrl: $json.body.websiteUrl, manualForm: $json.body.manualForm }) }}

nodes.notes: This is the ONE workflow in this library calling a real, built, tested contract - src/server/ (checkpoint 5 of the KB demo generator, this same repo). Request/response shape here is copied directly from src/server/README.md, not guessed. DEMO_GENERATOR_URL should point at wherever that service ends up running (Oracle box, alongside n8n, per the brief's infra split). The one still-uncertain part is the exact 'never error on 4xx/5xx' option name/nesting for this n8n version (options.response.neverError) - confirm against the real instance; without it, a 400/422/502 response throws instead of flowing into the IF node below.

nodes.name: Advance Opportunity to Pending Demos
nodes.notes: BUG FIX while extending this file for the object model migration: this node previously read '$json.body.opportunityId', but $json at this point is the demo generator's OWN response ({ok, unifiedKb, stepUsed} or {ok, stage, reason}, per src/server/README.md) - it has no '.body' field at all, so that expression was always undefined. Fixed to reference $('Generate demo webhook') directly, the same pattern the 'Alert: generation failed' node below already used correctly. Same Twenty CRM REST-shape uncertainty as W1.1. Stage stays on the Opportunity per CRM-OBJECT-MODEL.md's table (the deal-progress funnel stage is the Opportunity's job) - demoStepUsed MOVED off this node to the Location write below, since demo content/status is per-site, not per-deal.

nodes.name: Write demo status to Location
nodes.notes: NEW (object model migration): demo generation is inherently per-Location per CRM-OBJECT-MODEL.md, since src/server/'s /generate-demo call is itself scoped to one GBP/business. ASSUMES the triggering webhook payload now also carries 'locationId' (added alongside opportunityId) - whatever calls this webhook (the Demo Dashboard UI/action) needs to know which Location it's regenerating a demo for, which matters once an Opportunity spans more than one. demoStepUsed here correctly reads $json.stepUsed - unlike the two opportunityId/locationId reads, THIS field genuinely does come from the demo generator's own response (the current $json at this point), not the original webhook body. Add a demoSiteUrl field here once a real hosted-demo URL exists (the 'Demo Site' status badge Section 13 describes).

nodes.name: Alert: generation failed

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ severity: 'warning', source: 'demo-generation-trigger', message: 'Demo generation failed for ' + $('Generate demo webhook').item.json.body.vertical + '/' + $('Generate demo webhook').item.json.body.niche + ': [' + $json.stage + '] ' + $json.reason }) }}

nodes.notes: Calls the real alert-dispatcher workflow (phase-2-calendar-nurture-alerts/alert-dispatcher.workflow.json) now that it exists - was a bare placeholder webhook in an earlier version of this file. severity 'warning' not 'critical': a single failed demo generation is worth flagging but not urgent enough for the SMS channel that dispatcher reserves for critical alerts.
